description: This file defines an Allocator interface and its implementations for managing memory allocation of value objects, including a default heap allocator and a freelist-based allocator, used within the structured-merge-diff package of Kubernetes.

classes.name: heapAllocator
classes.description: Default heap-based allocator implementing the Allocator interface.

classes.name: freelistAllocator
classes.description: Freelist-based allocator for short-lived value objects, providing faster allocation and freeing.

classes.name: freelist
classes.description: Data structure managing a pool of reusable objects for allocation.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Frees or recycles a value object back into the allocator.
